primary.note: Tailwind blue-600. Lightens to #60a5fa in dark mode. Carries all primary actions, links, active nav, focus rings, AI markers.

accent-violet.note: Secondary accent. Title Similarity icon, chart slot 2. Underused as brand element.

status-approved.note: Approved status, low-similarity (safe) result, underexplored clusters, strict threshold zone.

status-pending.note: Pending review, moderately-similar result, emerging clusters, balanced threshold zone.

status-rejected.note: Rejected status, highly-similar (risk) result, saturated clusters, all error states.

bg-dark.note: Dark-mode page background. Elevated dark surfaces use #0f1a3a.

bg-light.note: Light-mode page background (slate-50). Cards sit white on top.

muted-light.note: gray-500. Section labels and meta. CONTRAST RISK on #080d24 dark bg (~3.4:1, fails AA sub-18px). Bump to gray-400 in dark mode.

display.purpose: Landing-page THESYS+ wordmark only. Two-color split (ink + blue). The only typographic drama in the system.

page-title.purpose: Authenticated page headings. Currently all identical text-2xl; provides no per-page wayfinding.

card-title.purpose: Thesis cards, feature cards, cluster names.

body.purpose: All descriptions and abstracts. Undersized (text-sm) for the abstract reading experience.

section-label.purpose: Uppercase tracked muted label. OVERSATURATED: appears on nearly every panel. Reserve for 2-3 structural breaks per page.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Resting card elevation, light mode only. Dark mode is flat at rest.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover on interactive cards (.thesys-card-lift), paired with translateY(-2px).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button. Solid blue, white text, blue glow on hover, scale-down on active.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost/outline button for Cancel, Clear, secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #374151; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f8fafc; border-color: #cbd5e1; }

components.name: Card Surface
components.description: Primary surface. Light: white + soft shadow. Dark: white-glass over navy, no shadow. Add .ds-card-lift for hover interactivity.

narrative.overview: THESYS+ is the digital memory of PampangaStateU's College of Computing Studies. Its visual system should read like a well-run institutional library with a research-grade AI engine underneath: disciplined, legible, quietly authoritative. The current implementation is a competent dual-mode React + Tailwind interface with a consistent card vocabulary and a single signature blue, but it borrows its grammar from generic SaaS dashboards rather than academic systems. Dark mode is the stronger personality: deep navy base with faint-white-glass panels, communicating depth through tonal layering rather than shadow. Light mode is flatter and safer. Both themes are hand-tuned and gated on an isDark boolean rather than adaptive tokens.
keyCharacteristics: Dual hand-tuned themes gated on an isDark boolean, not adaptive CSS variables
A single signature blue carries nearly all brand weight; violet is a secondary accent
Card-and-panel surfaces are the dominant layout primitive on every page
A four-channel status color language (emerald/amber/rose/blue) reused consistently for status, similarity scores, and trend saturation
Inline SVG charts only, no chart library
System font stack throughout, zero typographic identity
Design tokens are placeholders; the real palette is hardcoded Tailwind hex in JSX

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: A single blue carries primary actions, links, active states, and AI-feature markers. Do not introduce a second primary color; violet stays secondary.

rules.name: The Status Quartet Rule
rules.body: Emerald = good/safe/done, Amber = caution/pending/middle, Rose = risk/rejected/error, Blue = informational. Consistent across status, scoring, and trends. Never reassign these meanings.

rules.name: The Placeholder Token Rule
rules.body: tokens.css and tokens.js are marked PLACEHOLDER pending Figma palette. The live palette is hardcoded Tailwind hex in JSX. Treat the documented values as canonical.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Label Saturation Problem
rules.body: The text-xs uppercase tracking-wider section label is applied to nearly every container. When every section is labeled identically, labels stop marking hierarchy. Reserve for 2-3 structural breaks per page.

rules.name: The Dark-Mode-Is-Flat Rule
rules.body: In dark mode, surfaces carry no shadow at rest. Elevation comes from background lightness (glass over navy) and border opacity. Only floating layers get a dark shadow.

rules.name: The Hover-Lift Rule
rules.body: Interactive cards rise 2px and gain shadow (light) or brighter glass + border (dark) on hover via .thesys-card-lift. Static informational cards do not lift.

dos: Do keep the focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-400 pattern on every interactive element.
Do preserve the status-quartet color language and its consistent meaning across status, scoring, and trends.
Do keep the dark-mode tonal-layering approach (navy base, glass panel, #0f1a3a elevated). It is the strongest part of the current identity.
Do keep the SimilaritySlider, shimmer skeletons, soft-loading indicator, and .thesys-empty pattern.
Do keep the three-column navbar grid and portal-rendered drawers/modals.
Do use shadcn Badge as the single canonical chip and migrate raw span chips to it.
donts: Don't ship text-gray-500 body or label text on the #080d24 dark background; it measures ~3.4:1 and fails WCAG AA for sub-18px text. Bump to at least gray-400.
Don't rely on the system font stack as the final identity. Load one typeface.
Don't reach for the text-xs uppercase tracking-wider section label on every panel; reserve it for 2-3 real structural breaks per page.
Don't reproduce the generic AI-SaaS landing pattern: pulsing badge, giant name, grid-glow background, hero-metric stat row, 2x2 identical feature cards.
Don't let the graduation-cap emoji carry institutional identity. PampangaStateU CCS deserves real visual presence.
Don't add a second primary color. One blue. Violet stays secondary.
Don't keep SignInCard on its divergent bg-gray-800 / text-red-600 vocabulary. Bring it onto the navy + thesys system.
Don't maintain two near-identical surface classes (.thesys-card vs .thesys-panel) without a clear semantic distinction. Consolidate.
Don't use a doughnut chart for 8+ topic clusters; it is illegible at that count.
Don't ship the mobile drawer without focus trapping, or charts without role=img + aria-label.
Don't use Tailwind's default blue-600 as the brand color long-term; it is the AI-SaaS template tell. Commit to a deliberate institutional color.
